source: md/1_PRD.md FR-33 (P0, PS A, line 213: 'Security Deposit: 15-day clock for proof + Affidavit 3; 10% penalty to 31 May, 20% to 31 July; flag withdrawal after', APH cl. 2.25d-f) and the §7 rules table (line 244: 'Security Deposit proof + Affidavit 3 | 15 days; 10% penalty to 31 May; 20% to 31 July; withdrawn after | 2.25f'). The §11 alert table (line 289: 'Security Deposit due | Institution | Day 1, 10, 14; 31 May, 31 July | Bureau') gives the reminder cadence that rides the existing undertaking_due ladder (Phase 3.6).
note: PLACEHOLDER CONFIG — the 15-day proof window, the 10%/20% penalty percentages and the fixed 31-May/31-July penalty dates are AICTE regulatory values (APH cl. 2.25f). This file makes them data, not code, and keeps them advisory (DEC-0003): the security-deposit endpoint computes and displays the penalty band that a given date falls in and a 'withdrawal_flagged' marker once past the last penalty date, but nothing here gates, moves, withdraws or rejects a case — the actual withdrawal is a NEW REGULATORY STATE (rule 15 human gate) and is deliberately not triggered by this config. The 15-day proof clock itself is modelled as an Undertaking (obligation + due date + evidence) so it reuses the existing undertaking_due day-1/10/14 reminders; this file only carries the penalty schedule and the withdrawal marker. Activate or re-source only after a human records an official clause via the approval gate; until then every answer is labelled Unverified/placeholder.

obligation.label: Security Deposit proof + Affidavit 3
obligation.note: The 15-day window runs from the grant/list date; the proof and Affidavit 3 ride as an Undertaking (obligation + due date + evidence), so the day-1/10/14 reminders come from the existing undertaking_due ladder rather than a second clock.

penalty_schedule.note: PRD §7 line 244 — 10% penalty applies up to and including 31 May (APH cl. 2.25f).
PRD §7 line 244 — 20% penalty applies up to and including 31 July (APH cl. 2.25f); after it the case is flagged for withdrawal.

withdrawal_flag.note: PRD §7 line 244 — 'withdrawn after' 31 July. This sets a computed 'withdrawal_flagged' marker on the advisory snapshot for display only; it never withdraws the case. An actual withdrawal is a NEW REGULATORY STATE (rule 15 human gate), not a config change.

reminder_thresholds.note: PRD §11 line 289 — first reminder, day 1 of the 15-day proof window (rides the undertaking_due ladder).
PRD §11 line 289 — second reminder, day 10 of the 15-day proof window.
PRD §11 line 289 — final reminder, day 14 of the 15-day proof window (the day before it closes).
